description: This file defines an abstract base class for scheduler task implementations in the OpenMRS project, providing common functionality such as execution state management, initialization with task definitions, and lifecycle callbacks.

classes.name: AbstractTask
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base implementation for scheduled tasks in OpenMRS, managing execution state and task lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: An abstract method to execute the task logic, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isExecuting
methods.description: Returns whether the task is currently executing.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the task with a given TaskDefinition.

methods.name: getTaskDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the TaskDefinition associated with this task.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the task by clearing its task definition.

methods.name: startExecuting
methods.description: Callback to indicate that the task has started executing, setting the execution flag.

methods.name: stopExecuting
methods.description: Callback to indicate that the task has stopped executing, clearing the execution flag.
